messages:
alex.nguyen: Customer AcmeHealth reporting 403 on 'Edit billing' and 'Manage keys' in console after they renamed Okta group yesterday.

maria.kim: Any error text from console? request id?

alex.nguyen: UI shows 403 Permission denied. Network response payload: {"error":"insufficient_scope","required":"org:write"} request_id=hh-7f3a

alex.nguyen: Support ticket (#7890) includes steps to repro: 1) login via SSO 2) switch to org AcmeHealth 3) click Billing -> Edit plan -> 403

dev-support-bot: Noted. Checked audit logs: SAML/SCIM mapping event at 2026-03-15T21:04:12Z group rename 'Acme-Prod-Admins' -> 'AcmePlatform-Admins'

maria.kim: Hmm okta rename could change group claim value. Did their IdP mapping drop org:write scope in token exchange?

alex.nguyen: They use delegated service token flow for console edits. Token introspect returns scopes: ["org:read","projects:read"] — org:write missing.

sre-oncall: Could be token exchange proxy trimming scope when group claim name changes. We saw similar earlier but different symptom.

maria.kim: Can we repro locally? Alex can you paste the exchange call and headers (redact secrets)

alex.nguyen: Here's the exchange log (redacted):

POST /oauth/exchange
Headers: Authorization: Bearer <okta_assertion>
Body: grant_type=urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:token-exchange&resource=redwood-console
Response: 200 OK
{ "access_token":"...","scope":"projects:read org:read" }

maria.kim: That explains it — the exchange didn't include org:write. Looks like the SCIM group mapping that grants org:write is keyed off the old group name.

sre-oncall: Workaround for customer: reassign an admin via Admin API or manually re-add mapping in SCIM. Quick patch: call admin endpoint to add role.

alex.nguyen: Raw curl I used to grant project admin (works when run as org owner):

curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/orgs/{org_id}/roles" \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer <owner_token>" \
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
 -d '{"user_email":"ops@acmehealth.com","role":"org:write"}'

maria.kim: For immediate customer fix, we can create temporary owner invite or run that call. Long term we need to patch token-exchange to map by group id not name.

sre-oncall: I've opened eng-runtime ticket RINF-2473 to change mapping logic + add e2e test for group rename.

alex.nguyen: Customer wants ETA — can eng estimate? cc @maria.kim

maria.kim: I'll ping eng PM and flag as high priority. ETA request sent.

dev-support-bot: Escalation created: #RINF-2473, severity: P2. Linked support ticket 7890.

alex.nguyen: I'll send customer the manual fix steps and ask them to revert group rename if they can. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

maria.kim: Also adding note to docs about token-exchange group mapping gotcha.

sre-oncall: Postmortem note: consider emitting clearer error in console when org:write missing — 'missing delegated scope' instead of generic 403.
